question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. **INTRANSIGENT**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unyielding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intransigent"** refers to someone who is unwilling to change their views, opinions, or stance, even when faced with valid reasons or pressure. (अड़ियल)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite repeated requests, the manager remained intransigent about the new policy.
 

 
• **"Unyielding"** means firm, resolute, or unwilling to give way under pressure, which makes it synonymous with "Intransigent." (अडिग)

 
 
• **Example:** Her unyielding determination helped her overcome numerous challenges in life.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Intransigent'** is **'Unyielding'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Unyielding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Independent **(स्वतंत्र): Free from external control or influence; not dependent on others.

 
 
• **Example:** She is an independent woman who makes her own decisions.
 
 

 
• **Stubborn **(ज़िद्दी): Refusing to change one’s opinion or stance despite attempts to persuade.

 
 
• **Example:** His stubborn attitude often creates conflicts in group discussions.
 
 

 
• **Objective** (निष्पक्ष): Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.

 
 
• **Example:** The judge's decision was objective and free from bias.
